name: Lustra Studio
official_name_basis: ChatGPTプラグイン詳細画面の表示名
original_description: Create and edit jewelry and product images using your connected Lustra Studio account. Use color variations, pose-based listing images, multi-angle views, lifestyle scenes, virtual try-on and reusable AI models, alongside normal image generation and Batch Studio. Import reference images from your chat, reuse saved models, and bring existing project images into the conversation. Generation runs asynchronously using your account’s existing credits and plan limits. Results are AI-generated and should be reviewed before use.
